name: O-acetylbufotenine
summary: O-Acetylbufotenine, or bufotenine O-acetate, also known as 5-acetoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (5-AcO-DMT) or O-acetyl-N,N-dimethylserotonin, is a synthetic tryptamine derivative and putative serotonergic psychedelic.

pharmacology.text: O-Acetylbufotenine, or bufotenine O-acetate, also known as 5-acetoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (5-AcO-DMT) or O-acetyl-N,N-dimethylserotonin, is a synthetic tryptamine derivative and putative serotonergic psychedelic.

uses.text: The effects of O-acetylbufotenine in humans have not been assessed or reported. Alexander Shulgin speculated about O-acetylbufotenine in his 1997 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), but did not personally synthesize or test it.
